Win: chance at that stage, given you got there. Fair = 1/survive, the break-even
for always playing to that stage. Break even: your ladder scaled so perfect play
returns exactly 1. Step edge: what letting the pot ride through that stage
costs. Plan edge: always playing to that stage, then cashing out.
If cards could repeat: perfect play would return 1.03, and surviving all four
would happen 5.60% of the time (your rules: 6.31%). `busride verify` tests which
